name: openbb_index_search
description:
Meant to search market indices by name through OpenBB (obb.index.search).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query* (default S&P); provider (schema default fmp; when omitted the tool sends yfinance).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.index.search, so this tool currently returns an error object; alternatives: openbb_index_available for the full list.
Example: {"query": "Nikkei"}
